name: locked-development-setup
given: A checkout containing shared configuration and tests, uv on PATH, and a populated dependency cache
when: Syncing the locked environment offline and running lint, formatting, strict typing, and setup tests
then: All checks succeed in a separate environment without initializing learner history

name: scoped-tutor-contract
given: A checkout with a development CLAUDE.md, a scoped tutor policy in tutor/TUTOR.md and an optional Cursor pointer rule
when: Running practice tutor check, then removing a rule, importing the policy into CLAUDE.md, making the Cursor rule always apply, or un-ignoring .practice
then: The clean checkout passes and every broken variant exits 3 naming the problem, without creating learner history

name: curriculum-prerequisite-frontier
given: The committed catalog and ordered curriculum with six placed starters, and no learner history
when: Running curriculum check and next, then checking invalid custom maps with unknown references, cycles or missing assignments
then: The committed map passes and next lists Objective 1 and catalog LC1 Two Sum without internal technique metadata; invalid maps exit 3 and no learner state is written

name: source-aware-knowledge-export
description: Export selected public problem knowledge with portable identities and preserved source attribution
given: The committed LeetCode 1 package and registered reference manifests, with no learner state
when: Running knowledge export twice, exporting exactly hint level 2, and explicitly revealing the registered upstream solution
then: Default JSON contains only the statement and repeats identically, hint export adds exactly level 2, reference export retains MIT notice and origin hashes, and no learner state is created; malformed adaptation lineage is rejected before any lineage body is read
